name: QT Database: ECG Waveform Interval and Morphology Benchmark
description: The QT Database is an internationally recognized electrocardiographic benchmark curated by the NIH-sponsored PhysioNet team and the University of Zaragoza to design and evaluate algorithms for automated detection and timing of ECG boundaries (P-wave onset and offset, QRS onset and offset, and T-wave end). Comprising 105 fifteen-minute excerpts of two-channel surface ECGs sampled at 250 Hz, it draws from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, European ST-T Database, and sudden death risk cohorts. The benchmark contains over 3,600 manually audited beat segmentations by expert cardiologists, serving as the gold standard for validating automated QT interval measurement and cardiac repolarization analysis.
